title: GraphScent: Calibrating Directional Relevance Signals for Bounded-Context Code Localization
abstract: arXiv:2611.17527v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Running open-weight language models locally on a single consumer GPU requires replacing expanding multi-turn exploration histories with short, stateless code inspections. Stateless repository localization, however, hinges on a foundational question: when a frozen language model evaluates an unedited code entity from a compact view, which structural relationships make its relevance judgment informative about a nearby repair target? Studying Gemma 4 models across 211 real-world Python issues in 86 repositories, we uncover a systematic directional relevance asymmetry: zero-temperature relevance scores on enclosing scopes and upstream callers consistently separate true structural neighbors from hard lexical distractors, whereas scores on downstream callees, peer methods, historical co-change partners, and dense node embeddings remain near chance. Zero-leakage masked-scope probes and regressions controlling for lexical similarity and snippe

translated_title: GraphScent：校准方向性相关性信号以实现有界上下文代码定位
translated_abstract: 在单张消费级GPU上本地运行开放权重大语言模型，需要用简短的无状态代码检查来取代不断膨胀的多轮探索历史。然而，无状态的代码仓库定位取决于一个基础问题：当一个冻结的语言模型从紧凑视图中评估一个未经修改的代码实体时，哪些结构关系能使它的相关性判断对附近的修复目标具有参考价值？通过在86个代码仓库的211个真实Python问题上研究Gemma 4模型，我们发现了一种系统性的方向性相关性不对称现象：在零温度设置下，模型对外围作用域和上游调用者给出的相关性评分能够稳定地将真正的结构近邻与困难的词汇干扰项区分开来，而对下游被调用者、同层方法、历史共变伙伴以及稠密节点嵌入的评分则接近随机水平。零泄漏的掩码作用域探测实验以及控制词汇相似度与代码片段长度的回归分析（摘要在此处被截断）……
tldr: 该研究发现冻结语言模型对外围作用域和上游调用者的零温度相关性评分能可靠区分真正的结构近邻与词汇干扰项，而其他关系类型的评分接近随机水平，据此校准方向性相关性信号以实现单张消费级GPU上的无状态有界上下文代码定位。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals a directional relevance asymmetry in frozen LLMs—zero-temperature relevance scores on enclosing scopes and upstream callers reliably separate true structural neighbors from lexical distractors while other relation types remain near chance—enabling stateless, bounded-context code localization on a single consumer GPU.
